[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Amount: 28
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- Description: Governor time clarifying and unblocking the TWO repackaging events for the Vivi/Oscar 81% bar conversion (Kirsten Ritschel holder), 2026-10-27.
  
  Substantive contributions, not general oversight:
  1. ARCHITECTURE CORRECTION — asked "can't you just submit the whole payload to Edgar along with the image attachment and Edgar deals with it?" This was the decisive redirect. It is the documented canonical pattern (edgar_client.py:220-243 — Edgar scans the signed text for a GitHub URL and uploads the attachment bytes there via the Contents API). It replaced a wasted compression/base64 detour fighting the 50,000-char col G cap, and preserved the proof at full resolution (1,030,191 bytes).
  2. SCOPE DECISION — instructed MAIN as the output ledger (structurally correct: processBatchData_ and the settlement cleanup both hardcode MAIN).
  3. QUANTITY DECISION — booked 40 bars (40 x 50g = 2kg), resolving the 40-vs-90 ambiguity that had blocked the job.
  4. EXCLUSIONS — labour excluded from landed cost; QR codes deferred pending Kirsten's East Coast feedback.
  5. TWO GO-SIGNALS — approved submission of the batch event and then the repair+settlement sequence, each after reviewing a stated risk.
  6. CAUGHT A REAL COSTING ERROR earlier in the thread (Vivi bar conversion): $7.56/kg is BEANS pricing, not nibs; correct nibs cost is $27.25/kg, giving $2.038/50g bar. Wrong constant would have mispriced the bar.
  7. Corrected my methodology twice — demanded land-verified confirmation ("Submit it") and rejected unverified claims, which is what surfaced the silent-success GitHub bug instead of letting a dangling col O ship.
  
  METHOD AND CAVEAT — governor time is NOT log-instrumented the way mine is, so this 28 min is a CALIBRATED ESTIMATE matched to my measured active window (28 min total: 14m30s on event 1, 13m05s on event 2) rather than a measurement. Basis: read-and-reply involvement across 6 user turns in this thread, including 2 compaction-truncated resume approvals, plus the prior turn range where the $7.56/kg costing error was corrected. Flagging as estimate so it can be adjusted.
- Type: Time (Minutes)
